title: AudioComic TTS bake-off passage
notes: ~110 words. Exercises: neutral narration, three distinct voices (menacing male, urgent heroic male, commanding female), a merged vocalization (Tsk.), a pained scream, a weary sigh, and a shout. Keep this stable so renders are comparable across engines and across time.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The graveyard was quiet now. The lantern's light had gone out an hour ago, and the cold had come in after it.

segments.speaker: BLACK HAND
segments.text: Tsk. You should be honored. Not everyone gets to be a part of what comes next.

segments.speaker: HAL JORDAN
segments.text: Mera, we have to move. Whatever he's doing, it's already started.

segments.speaker: MERA
segments.text: Then we end it here. Get down!

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The ground split open. Hands, grey and clutching, tore up through the frost.

segments.speaker: MERA
segments.text: *sigh* It's never just one of them, is it.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Far below the city, something old and patient opened its eyes.
